title: Fault family — DimensionalProduct: the product of two quantity operands must land in a dimension the curated catalog recognises

citations.note: Dimensional product — exponent addition into a curated set — the validity argument these contracts cite

notes: Authored 2026-07-23; the file previously carried no family-level respellability block, which the schema requires because every cell inherits from it.

The band here is a curation boundary rather than a proof failure. A product whose dimension vector is coherent but uncurated is refused, and the licensed respelling is to declare the intermediate as a field of the dimension the author means, which is an ordinary declaration available at every occasion.

Residual, named: an author whose genuine domain dimension is absent from the curated set has no respelling within the surface — that is a surface decision for the owner, not a proof gap, and corpus measurement decides whether the case is real.
